# Botanical Architecture Dubai

> An experiential design studio in Dubai (also known as Botanical Dubai) that creates immersive botanical installations, brand activations, hands-on workshops, and bespoke event gifting, treating plants and florals as a creative and branding medium, not decoration.

## About

Every concept is custom-designed around the client's brand, audience, and space, ranging from a single feature installation to large-scale architectural work. Botanical Dubai works with retail, F&B, hospitality, and brand spaces, as well as weddings, corporate events, and intimate dinners.

## Services and Starting Prices

- **Living Installations**: architectural botanical design for retail, F&B, hospitality, and brand spaces. From AED 10,000 (Brand Living Art), AED 15,000 (Shop Design), AED 25,000 (Semi-Permanent Architectural Design).
- **Event Activations**: e.g. Botanical Bar, Pot Your Own Plant, Pilates + Petals. From AED 100 per guest.
- **Workshops**: e.g. Terrarium Building, Ikebana, Learn to Propagate. From AED 200 per guest.
- **Table-scapes**: weddings, intimate dinners, corporate meetings. From AED 2,500.
- **Gifting**: single-stem bouquets, branded test-tube cuttings. From AED 30 per unit.

## Design Scope Budget Slider

The live website includes an interactive "Design Scope" budget slider (AED 2,000-50,000+) that lets visitors explore what different budgets can achieve.
